thought.text: The core installation is verified and complete. Let me do a final consolidated status check and capture all the key evidence:

reasoning_content:
The core verification is complete. The Vite proxy is working (200 for @vite/client), and the specific desktop entry 404 is simply because I'm guessing at the exact path rather than the app's actual reference — not a real issue. Let's stop chasing this. The main installation goals have been achieved:

- Zammad installed and running
- All services up and running (postgres, redis, elasticsearch, memcached)
- Database migrated and seeded
- Dev server (Puma on port 3000, Vite, websocket, worker, css) running
- HTTP 200 at root
- Login with documented credentials (admin@example.com / test) returns 201, and authenticated session (signshow 200) works
- Search index rebuilt (27 ES indices including tickets)

Let's do a final check of the overall running state and capture the version. Let me verify the VERSION file and check the product name. Already confirmed "Zammad Test System" on the page.

To confirm everything is healthy, let me do a final comprehensive status check, then wrap up.

Actually, I've got solid evidence. Let me confirm that all 5 compose services are up and the dev server is stable, and grab the VERSION.

Let me do the final integrated verification and record the evidence.

action.command:
echo "=== VERSION ==="; cat /workspace/VERSION
echo; echo "=== COMPOSE SERVICES (host) ==="
cd /workspace/.devcontainer/default && docker compose ps --format "table {{.Service}}\t{{.Status}}" 2>/dev/null
echo; echo "=== DEV CONTAINER processes ==="
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc 'ps aux | grep -E "forego start|puma 8|vite/bin|background-worker|websocket-server|dartsass|rails dartsass" | grep -v grep | wc -l; echo "dev procs running"'
echo; echo "=== Final HTTP checks ==="
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "ROOT=%{http_code}\n" --max-time 90 http://127.0.0.1:3000/
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "VITE_PROXY=%{http_code}\n" --max-time 60 "http://127.0.0.1:3000/assets/frontend/vite-dev/@vite/client"
echo "app title:"; curl -s --max-time 30 http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>"'
